Naturally, I left no regrets behind. I gave it my all alongside her.
Still, you can't help but wonder... couldn't I have done more?

Ah, so you recognize me? Molto bene!
Such an adorable agnellino. Come, let me give you a hug!

And what she held out to me was...
...a bright red pair of maracas—

—Morendo. It seems your tension has yet to fade... Hmm.
Very well! Allow me to guide you to a place where you can become giocoso. Follow me!
U-Um... You're a Trainer at the academy, right?

It happened just the other day.
The Umamusume my senior was training departed from the racing world.
I am one who delivers upbeat musica to you.

Recalling my failed scouting attempt earlier... I turn my steps toward my room.
I was no longer even sure how I was supposed to fixate on winning.

...I guess I'll never get used to watching a girl I've trained walk away like this.
I mean, no matter how many times you experience it... ngh...

Oh? Is it not to your liking? There is no need to hold back, you know?
Be more comodo. Just take it adagio.

Her finishing burst was truly remarkable; she had the kind of talent that made you believe
she could contend in graded stakes if nurtured well. That made my coaching all the more passionate—

The answer is obvious, agnellino.
For there is only one thing to perform on stage!

Fufu. Awoken, have we, amore?
You were drawn in just like the children following the Pied Piper of Hamelin.

And when you do, it will be briiiillante!
Come, let me witness your melodia!

...There is a shadow hanging over your heart, is there not? I sensed a pianissimo.
Which is why, without question, I wish to make you energico!

...There were many close races. But she could never quite
take that final step. I wanted to bridge that gap for her, but...

She had a wonderful tempo to her running. Sometimes powerful, sometimes light and nimble,
her stride across the course was wonderfully rhythmic—

The Twinkle Series is a meritocracy.
Only the victors remain, and the defeated have no choice but to leave...

Sì! I saw you yesterday.
A doloroso melodia was overflowing from deep within you.

I watch the back of the departing Umamusume. ...How many times has this been?
Pushing them too hard, only to have them turn down my scout offers.

Here, take this.
An andante tempo will do just fine.

Before I knew it, my notebook was completely filled with notes about her running.
...Maybe, just maybe, with her...

...I'm sorry.
I just don't have the confidence to meet your intense expectations, Trainer...

Oops, pardon me. It seems I got a little carried away.
Liszt's pieces are beautiful, but one must still make an effort to be understood.

Now and then, a cheerful singing voice joins in.
It's a beautiful voice. Just who could it be...?

That is the reality of the Twinkle Series—full of dreams, yet utterly cruel.
That was precisely why a Trainer had to be relentlessly obsessed with victory.

Um, I've been having trouble with my training...
If you don't mind, could you take a look at my running?

Yes... I'm sorry...
At this rate, running in the Twinkle Series is completely out of the question...

Yet, in a world like that... what if?
What if one could simply run to their heart's content? Boundlessly.

Huh?! Does that mean... you're scouting me...?! 
I-I'm happy, but...
Before I knew it, I had rushed out of the Trainer's office and into the courtyard.

I make my way toward the sound.
It's such an uplifting, heart-stirring melody...

~~~~~♪ Barchetta mia~♪
Santa Lucia~♪ Santa Lucia~♪

She tried the maiden races again and again... but in the end, she couldn't break through.
So she decided to move on and focus on her higher education...

Th-Thank you so much for your guidance...
...I'm so sorry I fell short in so many ways...

Once again today, I watch an Umamusume training.
Without realizing it, my gaze had turned stern and critical.

Unfortunately, it's not an uncommon story... Roughly 70% of debuting Umamusume
leave the racing world without ever claiming a single victory—
If one could run purely for the sake of their own passion, then that would be—
Haaaaaaahhhhhーーー!!!
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*――

—Piacere, amore.
My name is Sounds of Earth.

And so, Sounds of Earth brought me
to a live stage in the middle of town.

...A lamentabile melodia.
Sounds like a cue for musica, wouldn't you say?

The next day. As I was working on my computer,
the sound of a violin drifted in from somewhere.

It seemed I had been watching her run for quite a while.
When I glanced at the clock—
